subject: Recap & ask: Redwood pilot — monthly burn range and PO path
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & ask: Redwood pilot — monthly burn range and PO path

Alex — thanks for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can get procurement moving: 

Summary of what we covered
- Pilot scope: 2 LLM-powered features (summarization + triage routing), estimated 10k–60k requests/day depending on adoption.
- Typical prompt lengths: 150–350 tokens in, 50–200 tokens out.
- Recommended model family: rdx-1-medium (balanced latency / cost).

Cost/units we discussed (illustrative)
- Baseline unit: $5.50 / 1M tokens (ranged pricing tiers available for committed volumes).
- With basic 20% commit (3-month pilot) we'd be able to offer $4.40 / 1M tokens.
- Example math: 10k requests/day * 400 tokens/request (roundtrip) ≈ 12M tokens/month ≈ $66 / month at $5.50/1M — note this is illustrative, we put a detailed estimate in the attached workbook.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the procurement threshold at which Acme prefers a PO vs credit-card/charge card for initial pilots? You mentioned there is a band — if you can share the numeric monthly spend (or an internal threshold) that helps us pick the right billing path.
2) Please share a rough expected monthly burn band (low/expected/high) for the pilot — we put a template in the attached ACME_MVP_usage_estimate.xlsx.
3) If PO is required, please confirm invoice recipient and whether Net30 is acceptable. Also, any mandatory PO language or PO number format we should include.

We've attached a short SOW and a usage workbook for your finance team. Happy to produce a formal quoteonce we have the band and invoice info.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: ACME_MVP_usage_estimate.xlsx (xlsx), Redwood_pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & ask: Redwood pilot — monthly burn range and PO path

Monica — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A couple quick clarifying questions from our side before I loop in engineering/finance: 

1) Can you confirm the $/1M token numbers across volume tiers (pilot vs committed)? The one-line you sent is helpful but finance will want a small tier table to attach to the quote.
2) Billing cadence — do you invoice monthly arrears or do you prefer upfront for committed discounts?
3) For the example math: are we counting both prompt + completion tokens in that calculation? (we want to make sure we align with our telemetry).

From procurement: Elena — our internal PO threshold is around $75k/month for SaaS vendors, below that we typically start pilots on a card or a short-term purchase order. If we do a pilot that ramps to >$75k/mo, procurement will require a standard PO and our contract team will want SOC2 evidence.

I'll wait for the pricing tier table and a short note on invoicing cadence and token counting and then I'll route to Finance + Procurement.

— Alex
Product Lead, Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | (617) 555-0199

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & ask: Redwood pilot — monthly burn range and PO path

Alex / Elena — appreciate the quick detail. Answers inline below and attaching a short tier table in-body for visibility: 

- Token counting: yes, our billing counts prompt + completion tokens (full roundtrip). We'll include a short mapping file so you can reconcile with telemetry.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly arrears for usage billing. For committed discounts customers can prepay or we can apply the discount retroactively at month-end depending on preferred flow — both options are supported.

Pricing tiers (simple view)
- Pilot (no commit): $5.50 / 1M tokens
- 3-month pilot commit (20%): $4.40 / 1M tokens
- 6+ month commit (40%): $3.30 / 1M tokens

Example monthly scenarios (round numbers)
- Low: 2M tokens/mo → $11 (pilot) / $8.80 (3-mo commit)
- Mid: 12M tokens/mo → $66 (pilot) / $52.80 (3-mo commit)
- High: 120M tokens/mo → $660 (pilot) / $528 (3-mo commit)

Procurement routing suggestion
- If expected monthly usage < $75k: start pilot on card / short PO (we can accept a short-term PO).
- If expected monthly usage >= $75k: we'll prepare a formal quote and SOW addressed to procurement with Net30 terms and standard PO language.

Action items
1) Alex — can you fill the attached workbook with a low/mid/high estimate (numbers or ranges is fine).
2) Elena — if PO is required, please confirm the exact invoice name & PO contact and any required legal language; we'll prepare a quote and attach SOC2 evidence (link below).

SOC2 report (public): https://redwood.ai/soc2-report
Link to attachments (drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/ACME/pilot-estimate

Thanks — Monica

Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & ask: Redwood pilot — monthly burn range and PO path

Hi Monica — procurement here. Confirming the $75k/month PO threshold Alex mentioned. For anything at or above that level we need: 
- Formal quote addressed to: Acme Health, Inc. (Tax ID: 04-1234567)
- Payment terms: Net30 (preferred)
- Certificate of insurance and SOC2 Type II report (redacted OK)
- Standard PO format: ACME-YYYY-NNNN (we will provide PO number once quote is approved)

If pilot stays under $75k/mo we can accept a corporate card or a short-term PO; however, for vendor onboarding we will still need the SOC2 report and basic contact details for invoicing. Please send a PDF quote with the pricing tiers and the expected burn examples.

Elena Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com
